business_model.narrative_summary: Granules India Ltd operates in the pharmaceuticals sector, focusing on generics and contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) services, particularly in peptides.

capital_allocation_philosophy.narrative: Management focuses on strategic investments in R&D and capacity expansion to support growth in higher-value products.

execution_track_record.narrative: Management has shown a commitment to transitioning the business model towards complex generics and CDMO services, with recent improvements in financial metrics.

forward_guidance.narrative: Management aims to achieve profitability in the peptide CDMO segment while maintaining growth in complex generics.

communication_transparency.narrative: Management has improved transparency in communications, openly discussing challenges and operational details.

governance_and_board.narrative: The board is focused on strategic oversight and ensuring compliance with regulatory standards.

promoter_skin_in_game.narrative: Promoter holding is at 38%, with recent selling activity raising concerns about commitment.
